name: rosslabs-lsp routing index
source_of_truth: routing.json is the source. ROUTING.md is rendered from it by `rosslabs-lsp route --markdown`; a test fails when they differ.
rule: Cross-file symbol questions (definition, references, callers, type, diagnostics, workspace symbols) go to RossLabs LSP. A symbol name works without a file position. Use grep/rg for strings, config, prose and logs, and whenever an answer says "ready": false. Run `rosslabs-lsp route <topic>` (MCP `route`) when unsure.

routes.cli: rosslabs-lsp def --symbol <name> [--path <root-or-file>]  |  rosslabs-lsp def <file>::<name>  |  rosslabs-lsp def <file>:<line>:<col>
routes.notes: Compiler-accurate across files, re-exports and overloads, where grep matches every same-named string.

routes.topic: Who uses or calls a symbol?
routes.notes: Each hit names its containing symbol. The declaration itself is excluded. An empty answer with "ready": false means unknown, not none.

routes.topic: What type or signature does a symbol have?
routes.notes: Returns the inferred type and documentation the compiler sees.

routes.topic: Does this file type-check or compile?
routes.notes: Whole-file query. Rust diagnostics can time out on a cold workspace; the build tool (cargo check, tsc) stays authoritative.
File outline. To find which file defines a name, use def/refs with --symbol and a directory --path.

routes.topic: Strings, config, prose, logs, or an unready server
routes.notes: Language servers do not index literals, comments, config or logs. Also fall back to rg when an LSP answer says "ready": false or the language has no server.
Fast (~0.2 s cold); never pooled by the daemon. Install: uv tool install ty.
The first refs call on a cold workspace took ~25 s; repeats take ~0.05 s while the daemon keeps it warm. Diagnostics can time out while indexing.
Pooled by the daemon. Functions carry argument labels (load(from:)); a bare name still resolves unless it is overloaded.
Needs a TypeScript install with lib/tsserver.js (or ROSSLABS_LSP_TSSERVER_PATH). Not pooled: each CLI query pays ~2 s.
Cross-file answers need compile_commands.json at the workspace root.

routes.topic: Any other language (Go, Java, Ruby, shell, ...)
routes.notes: No server is registered, so queries are refused with "no language server registered".

routes.topic: Agent hooks (Claude Code, Codex hook events, payloads, timeouts)
routes.cli: rosslabs-lsp compat --section agent-hooks; rosslabs-lsp hooks doctor [--drift]; rosslabs-lsp compat refresh <registry.json> --section agent-hooks --host ID [--dry-run]
routes.notes: Check before writing or changing hook configs on any host. `hooks doctor --drift` (MCP `drift: true`, default off) lists records to re-verify when an installed host version differs from the recorded one; `compat refresh` re-confirms them from local transcripts (no network). Builds older than the agent-hooks merge reject this section, and the error names the build date; reinstall to fix.

routes.notes: Spawns each agent briefly and times initialize and session/new. --first-token costs tokens.

routes.mcp: def, refs, hover, diag, symbols, route, doctor (deferred: load with ToolSearch "rosslabs-lsp")
routes.notes: MCP tools are deferred, so the model sees only names until ToolSearch loads them. The built-in LSP tool is only correct for languages with a registered lspServers plugin.

routes.use: MCP server rosslabs-lsp, or the CLI from the shell
routes.notes: Codex has no native LSP. Register the server under the name rosslabs-lsp pointing at the current binary.
